nodes.value: bind human evidence to quality vector
Authenticate sender/role and preserve task/correlation identity.
Specify ordering, retry, duplicate and expiration behavior.
Handoff authority must be subset of delegator authority.
Receiver must acknowledge assumptions, dependencies and custody.
Score completion, correctness, recovery, cost and human intervention separately.
Bind observations to exact agent/task/config/model identity.
Do not optimize cost by silently weakening authority, quality or verification.
Every child inherits stricter-or-equal authority and explicit budget.
Stop/reconcile outstanding child work when parent budget/cancellation terminates.
Keep independent evidence visible before aggregation.
Escalate unresolved high-impact disagreement instead of averaging it away.
Reviewer cannot mutate target artifact while reviewing.
Require concrete findings/evidence rather than generic criticism.
Verifier must consume artifact-bound evidence and declared acceptance criteria.
Conflict-of-interest/identity rules must be machine-checkable where required.
Preserve artifact version under review and review lineage.
Block publication/promotion until required reviewers/gates resolve.
Assign distinct research roles and evidence ownership.
Do not auto-promote novel claims into architecture without evaluation.
Represent citations, claims, replication and contradiction separately.
Bind package to exact claim/result and artifact digests.
Reject comparisons with material uncontrolled differences unless explicitly qualified.
Preserve raw run evidence behind summaries.
Declare population/sample/metric assumptions and missing-data handling.
Report effect size and uncertainty, not only p-values.
Freeze evaluation spec/environment before comparative runs.
Score end-to-end task outcome and policy adherence separately.
Capture action traces/receipts for failure attribution.
Benchmarks must include restart/checkpoint and stale-world conditions.
Measure cumulative error, intervention and resource use over horizon.
Fingerprint exact and near-duplicate content across datasets.
Record contamination confidence and disposition per benchmark/model.
Protect rater privacy and separate identity from public results.
Measure inter-rater reliability and adjudicate high-impact disagreement.
Separate measured facts from qualitative claims.
Cards bind to immutable dataset version/fingerprint.
Document excluded/unknown provenance and sensitive attributes.
Cards cannot grant authority; they document governed contracts.
Bind to exact tool version/implementation owner.
Bind card to agent definition/version and evaluation evidence.
Clearly distinguish default authority from optional delegated grants.
Show dimensions and raw blocker states, not only aggregate score.
Require risk disposition for unmaintained or vulnerable critical packages.
Maintain tested fallback or explicit no-fallback disposition.
Unknown external outcome must reconcile before retry to alternate provider.
Never imply remote freshness or capabilities while offline.
Queue/reconcile permitted deferred work with idempotency.
Provide signed import/export workflow for packages, updates and audit evidence.
Adapt capability to measured edge resources without changing security guarantees.
Handle intermittent connectivity and local persistence/reconciliation.
Separate organization/tenant administration from model authority.
Define supported topologies and operational responsibilities.
Validate issuer/audience/signature and claim mapping fail closed.
Avoid using mutable email/display names as sole durable identity.
Admin actions require explicit identity/authorization and durable receipts.
Separate operational admin from model-generated actions.
UI is a projection of append-only/canonical audit data.
Support correlation/search without leaking other tenants/secrets.
Make hard blockers and active incidents prominent.
Human controls act through governed APIs, not UI-local state.
Surface orphan/stale lease and budget exhaustion conditions.
Separate evidence state from generated narrative.
Preserve source/version and experiment lineage in drill-down.
Every deployed model maps to immutable artifact/config/eval evidence.
Model changes follow staged promotion and rollback controls.
